name: Women Wearing Pants
overview: Scripture clearly distinguishes between male and female attire, as seen in Deuteronomy 22:5 where wearing garments of the opposite sex is called an abomination to the Lord. The Old Testament prescribes specific clothing for men, such as linen breeches worn by priests (Exodus 28:42; Leviticus 6:10), underscoring the importance of gender-appropriate dress. While God shows no partiality among people (Acts 10:34), believers are called to honor His design, respecting distinctions in appearance as a reflection of His created order. Romans 14:2 reminds us that personal convictions vary, but the foundation remains obedience to God's commands regarding conduct and dress.
